question: An object is placed $30$ cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length $20$ cm. The image is formed at

options.text: $12$ cm in front of the mirror, real
$60$ cm in front of the mirror, real and inverted

solution: $\dfrac{1}{v} + \dfrac{1}{u} = \dfrac{1}{f}$ with $u = -30$, $f = -20$: $\dfrac{1}{v} = -\dfrac{1}{20} + \dfrac{1}{30} = -\dfrac{1}{60}$, so $v = -60$ cm: real, in front, magnified ($m = -2$) and inverted.
